homeIntro: Choose what you would like to do. No accounts, uploads, or complicated settings.
privacy: Your images stay on your device. They are processed in your browser and are never uploaded.
resizeDescription: Change the width or height of your image.
pdfDescription: Turn one or more images into a PDF.
error: We couldn't process this image. The file may be damaged, unsupported, or too large. Please choose another image.

adjustFinal: Adjust the size again without going back.
